title: Think, Explain, Express
sub: Buku pendamping Bahasa Inggris Kelas 11 SMA/MA
intro:
📌 Capaian Pembelajaran Fase F (ringkas)
  • Berdiskusi, memberi saran, dan menyatakan pengandaian secara lancar dan santun.
  • Menganalisis dan menghasilkan teks analytical exposition, explanation, surat pribadi dan formal.
  • Menafsirkan makna dan bahasa kiasan dalam lagu dan puisi.
cando: Memberi dan menanggapi saran serta tawaran.
Menjelaskan fenomena alam dengan explanation text dan passive voice.
Menulis surat pribadi dan surat keluhan formal.

sections.title: Feeling stressed before exams
lines: Bella
You look exhausted, Dafa. What's wrong?
Kamu terlihat sangat lelah, Dafa. Ada apa?
Dafa
I have three tests next week, and I can't focus at all.
Aku ada tiga ujian minggu depan, dan aku sama sekali tidak bisa fokus.
Bella
Why don't you make a study timetable? You'd better put your phone away while studying.
Bagaimana kalau kamu membuat jadwal belajar? Sebaiknya jauhkan ponselmu saat belajar.
Dafa
That's a good idea. But Chemistry is really hard for me.
Ide bagus. Tapi Kimia benar-benar sulit bagiku.
Bella
Would you like me to explain the reaction topic? I'm free on Thursday.
Mau aku jelaskan materi reaksi? Aku senggang hari Kamis.
Dafa
Yes, please! That would be a great help. Thanks, Bella.
Ya, tolong! Itu sangat membantu. Terima kasih, Bella.

goals: Memahami tujuan, struktur, dan unsur kebahasaan analytical exposition.
Menyusun argumen yang logis dengan bukti.

sections.title: Analytical exposition
paras:
Why Reading Habits Matter for Teenagers
Reading is one of the most valuable habits a teenager can develop. Although many young people now spend hours on short videos, reading books and long articles remains essential for success at school and in life.

Firstly, reading improves language skills. When students read regularly, they meet new words in context and learn how good sentences are built. As a result, their writing and speaking become clearer and more convincing.

Secondly, reading trains concentration and critical thinking. A long text requires readers to follow ideas, compare arguments, and draw conclusions, which are skills needed in exams, university, and the workplace.
Finally, reading opens windows to other people's lives. Novels and biographies help readers understand different cultures and feelings, making them more empathetic.
In conclusion, reading is not old-fashioned; it is a powerful tool. Therefore, teenagers should set aside at least fifteen minutes a day to read something meaningful.

sections.html:
Thesis
Pernyataan posisi penulis: membaca sangat penting bagi remaja.
Arguments
Alasan-alasan pendukung beserta penjelasan/bukti (firstly, secondly, finally).
Reiteration
Penegasan kembali posisi penulis (in conclusion).
sections.label: grammar
sections.title: Struktur analytical exposition

sections.html: Analytical exposition meyakinkan pembaca bahwa suatu hal benar/penting. Bedanya dengan hortatory exposition (Kelas 12): hortatory mengajak pembaca melakukan sesuatu dan ditutup dengan rekomendasi. Ciri kebahasaan: simple present, kata penghubung argumen, kata kerja mental (believe, think).

sections.title: Explanation text
paras:
How Does a Tsunami Happen?
A tsunami is a series of huge sea waves that are usually caused by an underwater earthquake. Indonesia is often affected by tsunamis because it is located where several tectonic plates meet.

The process begins when two plates under the ocean collide. One plate is pushed under the other, and pressure builds up for many years. When the plates suddenly slip, the seabed is lifted or dropped, and a huge amount of water is moved.

This movement creates waves that spread out in all directions. In the deep ocean, the waves travel as fast as a jet plane, but they are not very high. As they reach shallow water near the coast, they slow down and grow much taller.

Before a tsunami arrives, the sea sometimes recedes far from the beach. This is a natural warning sign. People are advised to move to higher ground immediately. Today, warning systems have been installed in many coastal areas so that lives can be saved.

sections.html:
General statement
Pengenalan fenomena: apa itu tsunami.
Sequence of explanation
Proses sebab-akibat secara berurutan (begins when…, this creates…, as…).
Closing (opsional)
Informasi tambahan: tanda peringatan dan sistem peringatan dini.

sections.title: Read the text
paras:
If I Were the Minister of Education
If I were the Minister of Education, I would make learning more meaningful for students all over Indonesia.

First, I would reduce the number of subjects students study at the same time, so they could explore topics more deeply. Second, I would make sure that every school had a good library and a reliable internet connection, even in remote islands.
I would also train teachers to use project-based learning. If students learned through real projects, they would understand why lessons matter.
Of course, I am only a student now. However, if more young people shared their ideas, policymakers would understand our needs better.

sections.ans: 1. melts · 2. had · 3. wouldn't have missed · 4. will
items: If you heat ice, it ((melts / would melt)).
If I ((have / had)) more time, I would learn to play the piano.
If she had left earlier, she ((wouldn't miss / wouldn't have missed)) the train.
We ((will / would)) go to the beach if the weather is nice tomorrow.

sections.html:
Malang, 3 October 2026
Dear Hana,

How are you? I hope you're doing well in Makassar. I'm sorry I haven't written for a while — school has been really busy.
Guess what? Our class won the short-film competition last week! We made a film about street children, and the judges loved it. I was the scriptwriter, so I'm really proud.
How's your new school? Have you joined any clubs? Write back soon and tell me everything.

Love,
Putri

sections.title: Personal letter

sections.html:
To: cs@tokobukuonline.id
Subject: Complaint about Order No. 58213

Dear Customer Service Team,

I am writing to complain about an order I placed on your website on 20 September 2026.
I ordered three English novels, but I received only two, and one of them had several damaged pages. In addition, the package arrived five days later than promised.
I would appreciate it if you could send the missing book and replace the damaged one as soon as possible. I have attached photos of the damaged pages and my receipt.

I look forward to your prompt reply.

Yours faithfully,
Arya Wicaksana
